newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian gunmen kill seven, including journalist.
newsitem.headline: Colombian gunmen kill seven, including journalist.

text.p: Seven people, including a journalist, were killed in the latest round of bloodshed across northern Colombia, authorities said on Thursday.
The journalist, 43-year-old Santiago Rodriguez Villar, was killed early on Thursday by unidentified gunmen in Sincelejo, capital of northen Sucre province, police said.

He was currently employed as the head of a local government press office. Police said they had no clues as to the identitiy of the two gunmen on a motorcycle who dragged him out of his house and shot him three times in the head.

In neighbouring Bolivar province, meanwhile, police said a previously unknown group calling itself "Death to Rustlers" had summarily executed seven men in and around the small town of Santa Rosa de Lima.
The bodies of the victims were found in three separate locations on Tuesday and Wednesday. police said. All were found lying dead with crudely made signs that read "cattle thief."
